prompt: Apply the explicit transformation: replace every A with B in `A7A2`.
A storage bin holds 12 parts. Three are removed and two are added. How many parts remain?
Choose an integer x satisfying: x>4, x<9, x is even, and x is not 6.

You can inspect only two of three sensors A,B,C. Exactly one is faulty. A and B are redundant measurements; C is independent. Choose two sensors so that one comparison can identify whether A or B is faulty if their readings disagree.

A service has intermittent timeout failures only under concurrent writes. Logs show no CPU saturation and no packet loss. Which next experiment best discriminates lock contention from database latency: (A) increase CPU, (B) record lock wait time and DB query latency simultaneously, (C) restart the service, (D) increase request timeout?
Infer a rule consistent with examples: f(2)=6, f(3)=12, f(4)=20. Give f(7) and the rule.
